Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the first Planner response after the second WebSurfer turn), the Planner incorrectly states that the birth year of Robert M. Young is 1950 ("The Ballad of Gregorio Cortez — Director: Robert Young — Birth year: 1950"). This contradicts the verified information from the previous WebSurfer turn which explicitly showed his birth date as November 22, 1924. This error propagates through subsequent turns and leads to an incorrect final comparison.
